emulators.comment: The events window's emulators (EVENTS-WINDOW-BRIEF.md). Pages served from localhost:5601 use these; firebase.json keeps the main window's. Hub and logging are moved too, so both sets can run at once: 4402 and 4502 (11 Oct, after the main window's runs and ours shared 4401/4501 and broke each other), and the UI on 4002.

functions.comment: The main window's functions (codebase hub), run only by tests that name functions (notify-e2e). Pages served from localhost:5601 call them on 5102 (egbc-auth.js).
